defect.cause: Canonical updateEntity invokes refreshHealthBar on every simulation step; refreshHealthBar assigned a new Size even when health and dimensions were unchanged. This produced repeated property assignments for every live toy.
defect.reproduction: Execute the entire canonical server in tests/roblox_server_harness.lua and intercept actual HealthBar Size writes during successive Heartbeat steps. Before fix each alive toy reassigns its unchanged bar width every step; new test asserts zero redundant writes. Damage-step case asserts exactly one immediate target update.

fix: Compare current X/Y/Z against the required health bar dimensions and assign Size only when any dimension actually differs. Preserve existing same-step damage refresh, geometry, combat and balance.
character_impact: PON/GUARDON/TANKURU/JUNK statistics, price, damage, speed, HP, spawn cadence and gameplay commands unchanged. Health bar size only written when its value changes.

tests.negative_control: Pinned whole-server pre-fix fixture when available and matching the previous Size assignment
